evidence.exact_quote: Let's do a quick search to confirm the headquarters of the Trump Organization and the connection to Ryan's tax reform.
The headquarters city of the primary business organization of Donald Trump is **New York City** (Trump Organization).
The nationality of Roald Amundsen is **Norwegian**.
No, Scott reached it on January 17, 1912. Amundsen reached it on December 14, 1911.
If the President was Obama, his "primary business organization" is unclear.
The most logical link is Ryan -> Tax Reform -> Trump (signed TCJA) -> Trump Org -> NYC -> Triangle Fire (1911) -> Amundsen (Norwegian).
Paul Ryan championed tax reform bill signed by Trump
The first person to reach the South Pole in 1911 was **Roald Amundsen**.
The search results confirm Trump Tower is the headquarters.
